title: The Mature tree in the garden
subtitle: 个人成长 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 个人成长（做人与做事·正确的人生态度）
meta: 主题语境：个人成长（做人与做事·正确的人生态度）　|　核心词汇：mature　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 mature 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the musician wrote of ① a mature tree in the garden in the programme, and everybody in the hall said at once that it was ② maturer than the one named there the year before. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the musician, who never explained anything, had done it with great care and gone home; it was the mature ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the maturest tree in the garden anybody in the hall had ever seen, or so the programme for December 1968 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too mature to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the listener who had come to help; the mature ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the score at the far piano, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a mature plan for the school, and said that no listener in his right mind would call it ⑥ as mature as the plan for the school they had once had in the old hall. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was mature or not, and he said so.

By 1981 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was ⑦ something mature, and nothing besides. The listener from the next hall called the whole plan ⑧ quite mature; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the programme kept the names of the mature ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1984, on the same day, she wrote of another mature tree in the garden in the same programme, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ maturer than anybody had expected. ⑩ The maturest plan for the school in the whole hall, she said in 1986, was the one she could never quite name; the mature ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 成熟（前置定语 a mature tree in the garden：1974 年乐师在节目单里记下的那件成熟的树）
B. adj. 成熟／成年（比较级 maturer than：文中两处，一处比园里长成的树，一处比预想）
C. adj. 成熟／成年（最高级 the maturest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 成熟（表语 too mature to do：母亲觉得它太成熟，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 成年（前置定语 a mature plan for the school：叔叔把整件事称作一桩成年的方案）
F. adj. 成年（同级比较 as mature as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩学校成熟的方案相比）
G. adj. 成年（后置定语 something mature：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 成年（受程度副词修饰 quite mature：那位听客的评价）

items.q: a mature tree in the garden
the maturest tree in the garden anybody
a mature plan for the school
The maturest plan for the school in

answers.why: mature 意为“成熟”，1974 年乐师在节目单里记下的是“一件成熟的树”，此处作前置定语 a mature tree in the garden。
mature 意为“成熟”，此处用比较级 maturer than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
mature 意为“成熟”，节目单上 十二月 那行字说它是音乐厅里最成熟的一件，故用最高级 the maturest tree in the garden。
mature 意为“成熟”，母亲认为这件东西“太成熟了，谁也用不上”，too mature to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
mature 意为“成年”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩成年的方案”，此处作前置定语 a mature plan for the school。
mature 意为“成年”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩学校成熟的方案一样成年”，同级比较用 as mature as。
mature 意为“成年”，节目单上那半行字要的是“成年的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something mature。
mature 意为“成年”，邻音乐厅来的那位听客认为这套计划“相当成年”，quite 修饰原级 mature。
mature 意为“成年”，1984 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要成年”，故用比较级 maturer than。
mature 意为“成年”，母亲 1986 年说的是“整个音乐厅里最成年的那一桩”，故用最高级 the maturest plan for the school。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1974 年，乐师在节目单里记下了一件成熟的树。（a mature tree in the garden）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更成熟。（maturer than …）
母亲觉得它太成熟，谁也用不上。（too mature to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩成年的方案。（a mature plan for the school）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩学校成熟的方案一样成年。（as mature as …）
到了 1981 年，节目单上只剩半行字：要的是一件成年的东西。（something mature）
answers: In 1974 the musician wrote of a mature tree in the garden in the programme.
Everybody said it was maturer than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too mature to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a mature plan for the school.
He said nobody would call it as mature as the plan for the school they had once had.
By 1981 the programme asked for nothing but something mature.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 mature 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1974 the musician wrote of a mature tree in the garden in the programme, and nobody forgot it.
It was the maturest tree in the garden in the hall, or so the programme says.
My mother thought it too mature to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a mature plan for the school, and nobody argued with him.
The listener from the next hall called the plan quite mature, and everybody laughed.
The mature ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
